lecciones.objetivo: Learn the keys 4, 5, 6, 7 with the left index finger and the right index finger. Without looking at the keyboard.
lecciones.tip: Your index fingers reach up to the number row and come back to the home row.

lecciones.objetivo: Learn the keys 3, 8 with the left middle finger and the right middle finger. Without looking at the keyboard.
Learn the keys 2, 9 with the left ring finger and the right ring finger. Without looking at the keyboard.
Learn the keys 1, 0 with the left pinky and the right pinky. Without looking at the keyboard.
Review what you learned so your fingers remember it on their own.
Learn the keys +, = with the right pinky. Without looking at the keyboard.
Learn the keys *, / with the right pinky and the right index finger. Without looking at the keyboard.

lecciones.objetivo: Learn the keys $, % with the left index finger. Without looking at the keyboard.
Learn the keys (, ), " with the right middle finger and the right ring finger and the left ring finger. Without looking at the keyboard.
Learn @ (AltGr + Q), # (Shift + 3) and & (Shift + 6) for emails and passwords.
lecciones.tip: The at sign @ is typed with AltGr + Q (the right Alt key and Q).
